content: आसङ्ग {%a.%} Uninterrupted, perpetual. .{@-गः@} .²1 Attachment, devotion (to any object) (to enjoy or protect it); सुख˚ लुब्धः <ls>K. 173</ls>; <ls>U. 3</ls>; चेतः स्वर्गतरङ्गिणीतटभुवामासङ्ग-मङ्गीकुरु <ls>Bh. 3. 60</ls>. .²2 Intentness, close application. .²3 Contact, adherence, clinging; (पङ्कजम्) सशैवलासङ्गमपि प्रकाशते <ls>Ku. 5. 9</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">3. 46</ls>; व्रततिवलयासङ्गसंजातपाशः <ls>Ś. 1. 33</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 14</ls>; अनासङ्गः absence of consolation; <ls>Māl. 2</ls>. .²4 Association, connection, union; त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गम् <ls>Bg. 4. 20</ls>; so कान्तासङ्ग <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Fixing, fastening to. .²6 Pride about the authorship of a thing (कर्तृत्वाभिमान), .²7 That which is fastened; <ab>cf.</ab> उत्तरासङ्ग. .²8 Waylaying (?). .{@-ङ्गम्@} A kind of fragrant earth (सौराष्ट्रमृत्तिका). .{@-ङ्गम्@} {%ind.%} Without interruption, eternally.
